[SWS_CM_10328] Invoke Field Notification receive handler
⌈
In case a ReceiveHandler was registered using the SetReceiveHandler()
method (see [SWS_CM_00181]) of the respective Field class for the Notification
event determined according to [SWS_CM_10325] this registered receive handler shall
be invoked when the corresponding subscribed Notification event is received.
